title: What Is the RNA World Hypothesis?
summary: Stated Clearly explains the RNA world hypothesis, which resolves the chicken-or-egg problem of genes versus enzymes by proposing that RNA once did both jobs. It outlines how evolution could begin with RNA chains alone.
why: HN recommends it as an engaging, brief overview of the RNA world idea.
